system.description:
Exposure to radiation has charged your system and given you new abilities.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.tAFBYH96UfVO71Lb]{Nuclear}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Self Control powers category

• Select from Technological powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.6EAD0B0yyIIA3gEA]{Radioactive Recharge}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.AqTQglLCehByjYg9]{Unstable Reaction}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.yLyR7fbx6nLZL361]{Wither}

Gain one of these Green abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.S52duNILjAA97FN8]{Charged Up}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.CVrbqhjhnS1V3wA0]{Dangerous Lash}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.e78bNYzODuaZzcJa]{Radioactive Aura}
Archetype

Roll d10, d8, d6 for archetype selection.
